title: Bora Employer Pipeline Evidence Record
description: Canonical truth-layer record for one piece of evidence about Bora's experience. Evidence records must trace to an original source and must not contain invented outcomes, unsupported equivalence, or silently upgraded certainty.

evidence_id.description: Permanent unique identifier for this evidence record.

experience_id.description: Identifier of the experience or project this evidence belongs to.

fact.description: Atomic factual statement supported by the cited source. It must not introduce an unmeasured outcome, unsupported scope, or stronger claim than the source supports.

capabilities.description: Capabilities directly demonstrated or supportably evidenced by this record. Empty array is permitted when no capability can yet be assigned without interpretation.

technologies.description: Tools or technologies directly supported by the source. Empty array when none are evidenced.

evidence_state.description: Evidence certainty state. These are the only states permitted by the Blueprint.

original_source.description: Original source supporting the evidence, such as code, GitHub, project documentation, approved stakeholder material, employment records, university records, or another Level 0 source.

source_location.description: Specific location within the original source where the supporting evidence can be found, such as file path, section, line range, page, commit, worksheet, or document heading.

safe_for_external_use.description: Whether this evidence may be used in external-facing materials such as resumes, applications, networking, or interviews.

notes.description: Optional clarifications, caveats, interpretation boundaries, or provenance notes. Null when no note is needed.

limitations.description: Explicit limits on what this evidence proves. Optional but strongly useful where scope could otherwise be overstated.

stakeholders.description: Stakeholder roles directly supported by source evidence. This field is optional and should not contain inferred people or relationships.

workflow_stage.description: Optional workflow stage directly associated with the evidence, such as requirements, build, validation, UAT, deployment, handoff, reconciliation, or monitoring. Exact vocabulary is an implementation choice, not a Blueprint-defined enum.

tests.description: Tests, checks, or validation activities directly supported by the source.

outcome.description: Measured or directly observed outcome only. Null when no outcome is supported. Never invent time saved, percentages, productivity gains, or business impact.
